2126281984368427315.en_summary: The memory upcycle in two charts. DRAM: contract prices climbing in 3Q25, up ~45% QoQ by 4Q25, 1Q26 peak with blended ASP roughly doubled (PC DDR5 up ~110%), 2Q26 another ~60% (server DDR4 ~70%). NAND: later, ~+30% in 4Q25, ~+57% in 1Q26, ~+75% in 2Q26, Enterprise SSD ~+80%. Forecast: 3Q26 DRAM ~+15% NAND ~+20%, 4Q26 both ~+10%, 2027 DRAM flattens to low single digits, NAND turns negative from 2Q27 falling 10–15% QoQ by 4Q27. Prices still rising but rate of change peaked in 1H26, NAND rolls over before DRAM. $DRAM $MU $SKHY $SNDK
